description: This file defines a class 'StandardDeviations' providing static methods for calculating various types of standard deviation (STDEV, STDEVA, STDEVP, STDEVPA) in a spreadsheet calculation context, using other variance functions.

classes.name: StandardDeviations
classes.description: Provides static methods to compute various standard deviations used in spreadsheet calculations.

methods.name: STDEV
methods.description: Estimates standard deviation based on a sample, using Variances::VAR.

methods.name: STDEVA
methods.description: Estimates standard deviation based on a sample, including numbers, text, and logical values, using Variances::VARA.

methods.name: STDEVP
methods.description: Calculates standard deviation based on the entire population, using Variances::VARP.

methods.name: STDEVPA
methods.description: Calculates standard deviation based on the entire population, including numbers, text, and logical values, using Variances::VARPA.
